info.name: API
info.description:
# API Collection Documentation

This collection contains endpoints meant for interacting with [Tanta Financial System API](https://github.com/AlMahllawi/tanta-financial-system-api).  
_Note: It's assumed that the database is filled with some dummy data, if not, use the seed or contact us._  
_For detailed examples of requests and responses, please refer to the saved examples within each request in this collection._

---

## Getting Started

First of all, to be able to test the endpoints, authenticate (using `Users/Authenticate` endpoint) as `admin` with the default password: `admin1234`.

---

## Paging

Wherever this is a "list" endpoint e.g. `Users/List`, paging is used. It's simply providing two query parameters `pageNumber` and `pageSize`.  
As the name suggests they determine the number of the page and the size which is the amount of elements. If absent the default values are used (Page number 1 with the size of 10).  
The page information is also returned in the response body in `page` key with a useful property called `last` so that one could know how much pages are left till end.

- `pageNumber` (integer): The page number to retrieve.

**Path Variables:**

- `:name`: The username of the user whoseto be viewed.

- Validates user credentials (username and password).
    
- Returns an authentication (`token`, `user`) on successful authentication.
    

### Request Body Parameters

- `name` (string, required): The username of the user to authenticate.
    
- `password` (string, required): The password for the user.
    

### Usage Notes

- The request will fail if invalid credentials are provided.
    
- all dummy users have the same password `Password1234` so that one can simply authenticate as any of them to be able to play around and test the different use cases in the system.

**Path Variables:**

- `:name`: The username of the user whose password will be updated.
    

**Request Body:**

- `password` (string, required): The new password for the user.
    

**Notes:**

- A user can change (him/her)-self's password
    
- An admin user can change any user's password

item.name: Documents

request.description:
## Request

- **Body Type:** `multipart/form-data`
    
- **Required Field:**
    
    - `file`: The file to upload. Must be included in the form-data body.
        

## Uniqueness Requirement

Each document name must be unique for the user uploading it. Attempting to upload a document with a duplicate name will result in a conflict error.

## Successful Response

The body includes a `DocumentURI` field (format: `uploaderName/documentName`). This URI can be used to reference or attach the uploaded document in other API operations (refer to `Transactions/Document` folder for more information in this manner).

response.name: Conflict

request.description:
## Path Variables

- `uploaderName` (string): The username of the account owner.
    
- `document` (string): The name of the document to delete (e.g., 'schedule.pdf').
    

_Note: this endpoint only deletes the document but it doesn't remove it from the system entirely, since a reference to the document still exists in any transaction it was attached to._

This endpoint allows you to request and download a document by specifying the userName and documentName as path variables.

## Path Variables

- `uploaderName`: The user who owns the document.
    
- `documentName`: The name of the document to retrieve.
    

_Note: If a document has been deleted, it will not be served even if a reference exists in an attached transaction._

item.name: Forwards

request.description:
## Path Variables

- `id`: The unique identifier of the transaction to forward.
    

## Request Body Fields

- `receiverName` (string, required): The username of the user to recieve the transaction.

## Path Variables

- `id`: The unique identifier of the transaction to view its forwards.
    

## Available Query Parameters

- `pageNumber` (integer): The page number to retrieve.
    
- `pageSize` (integer): The number of forwards per page.

## Path Variables

- `id` (integer): The unique identifier of the parent transaction.
    
- `forwardId` (integer): The unique identifier of the forward transaction to update.
    

## Request Body Fields

- status (string, required): The new of the transaction forward, could be: `waiting`, `needs-editing`, `rejected`, `approved`.

## Path Variables

- `id` (integer): The unique identifier of the parent transaction.
    
- `forwardId` (integer): The unique identifier of the forward transaction to delete.

item.description:
Once a transaction been created, its creator can forward it to another user. The user that received the transaction can reforward it to another user as well.

The reciever must update the forward status before forwarding the transaction.

Only the last reciever is able to forward the transaction, not the creator not an admin, only the last reciever.

request.description:
## Request Body Fields

- `title` (string, required): The title of the transaction.
    
- `description` (string, required): A detailed description of the transaction.
    
- `typeName` (string, required): The type/category of the transaction.
    
- `priority` (string, optional): The priority level of the transaction, can be either: `high`, `medium` or `low`.
    
- `documentsURIs` (array of strings, optional): List of document URIs associated with the transaction.
    

## Usage Notes

- Ensure all required fields are provided in the request body.
    
- The response will contain details of the newly created transaction or an error message if the request is invalid.

## Available Query Parameters

- `pageNumber` (integer): Page number for pagination.
    
- `pageSize` (integer): Number of transactions per page.
    
- `typeName` (string): Filter by transaction type.
    
- `fulfilled` (boolean): Filter by fulfillment status (e.g., true or false).
    
- `priority` (string): Filter by priority (e.g., "medium").
    
- `creatorName`, `senderName`, `receiverName` (string): Filter by user names.
    

**How to Use:** Add any desired query parameters to refine your search.

## Path Variables

## Request Body Fields

- `title` (string): The new or updated title of the transaction.
    
- `description` (string): A description of the transaction.
    
- `typeName` (string): The type/category of the transaction.
    
- `priority` (string): The priority level (e.g., 'high', 'medium', 'low').
    
- `fulfilled` (boolean): Indicates if the transaction has been fulfilled (true/false).
    

## Usage Notes

- Only the fields provided in the request body will be updated; others remain unchanged.
